## Problem and expected behavior

Do not include secrets, private inventories or confidential vulnerabilities.
Use SECURITY.md for confidential reporting.

## Reproduction

Include a minimal synthetic project definition, source revision and steps.

## Environment and evidence

Identify exact OpenBSD release/architecture/boot mode for native behavior.
Distinguish host checks from native results. Include sanitized error outcomes,
interruption/recovery state and disposable fixture teardown where relevant.
